integrity: Analytical proof and independently replayable finite checker included. Unrestricted claims rely on proof rather than finite samples; priority remains qualified where historical full texts were inaccessible.
scientific_limitations: Real equal-mass signals on a nonperiodic path, one mean-preserving Euclidean group shrinkage step; no claims for other graphs, weights, overlapping groups or different penalties. The exact positive-threshold coefficient is not attained by distinct finite inputs for n >= 3.
title: Sharp path-variation instability of centered Euclidean group soft thresholding
